meaning.evidence: Every point survives, from the compliance burden to the API use case; nothing added.

register.evidence: Retold throughout but on the light side of level 3; a handful of terms ("knock up", "grunt work", "dead easy") over plain casual English. No swearing, allowed under vulgarity 1.

tone.evidence: Keeps the friendly, persuasive product tone.

flow.evidence: Reads smoothly; "Steering clear of a traditional CMS means steering clear of headaches" is a deliberate echo that works.

variety.evidence: Reasonably varied, without leaning on any term.

essence.evidence: Unmistakably the cloud.gov Pages pitch, with its headings, bullets and diagram link intact.
